package nats

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

const teacherSubjectPrefix = "teacher."

// Publisher lazily connects to NATS and waits for JetStream acknowledgements.
// An initial broker outage does not prevent the HTTP service from starting;
// unpublished events remain in PostgreSQL and every later relay attempt retries.
type Publisher struct {
	URL            string
	Name           string
	ConnectTimeout time.Duration

	mu         sync.Mutex
	connection *natsgo.Conn
	jetStream  natsgo.JetStreamContext
}

// Publish sends the canonical envelope with event_id as JetStream deduplication key.
func (publisher *Publisher) Publish(ctx context.Context, event domain.IntegrationEvent) error {
	if publisher == nil || strings.TrimSpace(publisher.URL) == "" || publisher.ConnectTimeout <= 0 {
		return errors.New("invalid NATS publisher configuration")
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(event.Subject, teacherSubjectPrefix) || event.EventID == "" || !json.Valid(event.Payload) {
		return errors.New("invalid teacher integration event")
	}
	jetStream, err := publisher.connectionContext()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	message := natsgo.NewMsg(event.Subject)
	message.Data = event.Payload
	message.Header.Set(natsgo.MsgIdHdr, event.EventID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Event-ID", event.EventID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Correlation-ID", event.CorrelationID)
	if event.CausationID != "" {
		message.Header.Set("X-Causation-ID", event.CausationID)
	}
	message.Header.Set("X-Schema-Version", strconv.Itoa(event.SchemaVersion))
	_, err = jetStream.PublishMsg(message, natsgo.Context(ctx))
	return err
}

// Close closes the current connection. A later Publish reconnects lazily.
func (publisher *Publisher) Close() {
	if publisher == nil {
		return
	}
	publisher.mu.Lock()
	defer publisher.mu.Unlock()
	if publisher.connection != nil {
		publisher.connection.Close()
	}
	publisher.connection = nil
	publisher.jetStream = nil
}

func (publisher *Publisher) connectionContext() (natsgo.JetStreamContext, error) {
	publisher.mu.Lock()
	defer publisher.mu.Unlock()
	if publisher.connection != nil && !publisher.connection.IsClosed() && publisher.jetStream != nil {
		return publisher.jetStream, nil
	}
	connection, err := natsgo.Connect(
		publisher.URL,
		natsgo.Name(publisher.Name),
		natsgo.Timeout(publisher.ConnectTimeout),
		natsgo.ReconnectWait(time.Second),
		natsgo.MaxReconnects(-1),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	jetStream, err := connection.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		connection.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	publisher.connection = connection
	publisher.jetStream = jetStream
	return jetStream, nil
}
